channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Sara Ali Khan avoids Kartik Aaryan; clings to Aditya Roy Kapur during puja brunch, netizens fat shame Aditya
item.description: Inside photos from Anurag Basu's Saraswati Puja went viral, showing Sara Ali Khan sitting between alleged ex-boyfriend Kartik Aaryan and her Metro… In Dino 2 co-star Aditya Roy Kapur. Though she seemed to avoid Kartik initially, she was seen only posing with Aditya.

item.title: Russia eyes India's regional aviation market, showcases civil aircraft at 'Wings India 2026'
item.description: Russia showcased its IL-114-300 and Superjet SJ-100 at Wings India 2026, aiming to enter India's regional aviation market. Targeting tier-two and tier-three cities under the UDAN scheme, Russia plans local manufacturing and assembly, offering aircraft sales, maintenance, and long-term industrial opportunities.

item.title: PM Modi praises Gen Z 'bhajan clubbing' trend, calls youth 'heroes' of Startup India in '2026 is the new 2016' reflection
item.description: In the 130th episode of his monthly radio programme, Mann Ki Baat, Prime Minister Narendra Modi praised the Gen Z trend of 'bhajan clubbing', calling it heartening to see the dignity and purity of devotional songs maintained even in modern, concert-like settings. He highlighted how today's youth are incorporating devotion into their lifestyles, creating a new cultural trend while upholding the core spirit of spirituality.

item.title: Constables to IPS officers, 52 J&K Police personnel honoured for bravery and service
item.description: Recognising acts of courage and dedicated service, 52 Jammu and Kashmir Police officers and personnel were conferred gallantry and service medals on Republic Day. The list features awardees from all ranks, highlighting contributions made in challenging law-and-order and security conditions.

item.title: Jammu meat seller arrested by Punjab Police for links with Pak-based terrorist Shahzad Bhatti
item.description: Punjab Police's State Special Operation Cell has arrested a Jammu-based meat seller, Raman Kumar, for his alleged links with Pakistan-based terrorist Shahzad Bhatti. Police say the accused was in contact with Bhatti through social media, helped fund terror activities and was involved in the Ambala police station blast case.

item.title: 'Our Constitution has defined justice, brotherhood': President in address to nation on R-Day eve
item.description: President Droupadi Murmu, in her address to the nation on the eve of Republic Day She hailed the valour of the Armed Forces, contributions of farmers, women, youth and professionals, recalled Dr B.R. Ambedkar's emphasis on democratic participation, and reflected on India's journey and achievements, setting the tone for Republic Day celebrations marking the adoption of the Constitution in 1950.

item.title: India's tax-to-GDP ratio reaches 19.6 pc, structural reforms key to further gains: Report
item.description: The upcoming Income Tax Act, 2025 is likely to boost transparency and formalise more of the informal economy, as tax collections are now growing faster than nominal GDP, signalling healthier revenue buoyancy.

item.title: CRPF dismantles Maoist arms factory at Sukma-Bijapur border
item.description: The CRPF successfully dismantled a suspected Maoist arms and explosives factory along the Sukma-Bijapur border in Chhattisgarh. Acting on intelligence, teams raided the Palaguda forests, uncovering hidden caches used for manufacturing weapons, thwarting plans for a major incident

item.title: Padma awards 2026: Dharmendra, Achuthanandan conferred Padma Vibhushan; Uday Kotak, Harmanpreet Kaur, Rohit Sharma among awardees
item.description: The government has announced 131 Padma Awards on the eve of Republic Day 2026, with veteran actor Dharmendra and former Kerala Chief Minister V.S. Achuthanandan receiving the Padma Vibhushan posthumously.
